description: I'm creative, responsible, and interested in science and space. I enjoy teamwork and sharing ideas. I'm looking for creative, organized, and responsible teammates who work well together.
summary: Auritas Team. Our project is an educational game about the equipment that NASA left on the Moon and Mars. Through this game, players can learn about different rovers, machines, and tools that were used in space missions. They can discover what these objects did, why they were important, and what scientists learned from them. Our goal is to make learning about space more fun, interesting, and easy for students. Even though these machines were left behind, their discoveries are not forgotten.
